data_source: Measured-self-discharge-gated COMSOL transport plus FE-informed virtual wireless LC spectra; not experimental wireless measurements
split_rule: grouped by virtual device; no device appears in more than one split
id_scope: calibration-controlled sensor-transfer envelope plus tissue, coupling, and measurement variation
ood_scope: wider tissue, component, coupling, calibration, kinetic, and measurement ranges
state_definition: early: t<20 min; active release: t>=20 min while V>=0.8 V; post-release diffusion: after V<0.8 V
